It covers γ_4 of exponent 9 (e.g. γ_4 ≅ C_9), the case that Remark 6.13 leaves open, for this type of Q_ab; for γ_4^3 = 1 it is a case of Theorem 6.11. Star.two_smul_gen_eq is the exact identity (⋆) of the proof of Theorem 6.11, for Tahara's data and any admissible τ in a group of class ≤ 4, with no condition on γ_4; the Lean proof of Theorem 6.11 does not use it. GroupDimension.Ab399.D_five_eq_bot_of_class_four_ab399 takes Tahara's inclusion as a hypothesis, the unprefixed one discharges it. Only the finite form of class ≤ 4 is in Lean; the general form D_5(G) = γ_5(G) for G_ab ≅ C_3 × C_9 × C_9 is not formalized.
